notes: A Timer tab in the side pane for presentations given live: a stopwatch beside the notes page, with the asked-for length and + Time to comment. It is offered to a student who has a notes page and no video.

A YouTube or Vimeo video played in the app has buttons to skip 10 seconds and change speed, and Space, J and L work on it. Video files have a Float button that keeps the video in a small window on top. Google Drive’s player can’t be driven from here.
